verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical. Both crop the photo hard and upscale it until it is soft and blurry, and both lose the original's vase and much of the room. Both also show a pale, full-width band (roughly y≈170–600) behind the purple panel, which looks like a compositing artifact rather than a deliberate layer. The headline is readable and keeps its hierarchy and brand purple in both; B's text is marginally heavier, but the difference is not meaningful.
